title: briza maxima var. rubra
intro: Briza maxima var. rubra, commonly known as red quaking grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Briza maxima var. rubra include its use as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, which can help to relieve symptoms of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
